# PATCHES.md (reference-snapshot usage + semantic comparison)

> `signoz-0.97.0/` is the read-only reference snapshot generated by `take-snapshot.sh` (reproducible, not committed),
> used only to understand the SigNoz 0.97.0 query semantics. It is not part of the build and must not be copied verbatim (M4 review decision, see design doc §5.2/§7).
> The table below records the trade-offs made by `src/signoz/` (the data-contract layer shared by all themes) against that snapshot.

| SigNoz source file | Implementation in this repo | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `api/v5/queryRange/prepareQueryRangePayloadV5.ts` | `src/signoz/queryPayload.ts` | `mapPanelTypeToRequestType` mapping matches value for value; builder/formula/promql/clickhouse envelope structures match; `start/end` are in milliseconds; `formatTableResultForUI` is true only for table; the `variables` type field is optional; `groupBy/selectColumns` are mapped from frontend to API fields per `createBaseSpec` (`key→name`, etc.; passing them through directly returns 400, see bug-track) |
| `api/v5/queryRange/convertV5Response.ts` | `src/signoz/v5Response.ts` | Parsing parity for `time_series` (results→series→labels/values), `scalar` (columns+data), `raw`, and `distribution`; scalar has two shapes: columnar→tables, series-shaped (pie/value style)→series (mirrors upstream `aggregations?.length>0` taking the time-series branch); time-series legends follow the observable behavior of `getLabelName`/`getLegend` (template `{{k}}` replaced from labels, empty template with a single label takes the bare value), internal response `alias` values (e.g. `__result_0`) must be ignored; column-name priority is alias > legend > expression (never take legend when there are multiple aggregations) |
| `constants/queryBuilder.ts PANEL_TYPES` | `src/signoz/panels.ts` | Enum values match verbatim (`graph/value/table/list/trace/bar/pie/histogram/row`) |

History: M2–M3 used the "same contract, independent implementation" approach (the table above is the comparison from that time), the second half of M3 pivoted to a 100% replica (`src/vendor/`, now deleted), and the M4 decision rolled back completely to a self-built UI + theme plugin architecture. The old implementation was removed together with vendor and is not kept.
